  "say": "I'll take the pad and sketch us a fish. Tail fin on the left, nose on the right. Tom, can you take the start when I've got stroke 1 down?",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 8,
  "point": [3, 5],
  "pad": "take",
  "sketch_clear": true,
  "sketch": [
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[3,5],[8,7],[14,6],[20,7],[24,10]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[24,10],[20,13],[14,14],[8,13],[3,15]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[3,5],[6,10],[3,15]]},
    {"type": "label", "x": 19, "y": 9, "text": "eye"}
  ],
  "do": "continue",
  "notes": "Animal: fish facing right, tail fin on left. Stroke 1 = top body to nose then bottom back to tail tip, starts at START (tail top, 3,5). Stroke 2 = tail fin notch (6,10). Eye at about (19,9). Trace stroke 1 first; someone must be on it since everything grows from it."
